verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a Library feature that imports from PDF, BibTeX, RIS and Zotero and makes the collection 'searchable' and 'AI-powered', with search and gap-finding over it. However, the evidence does not show the research agent or Deep Search running over the user's uploaded corpus, as opposed to Consensus's own 200M-paper index. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent/synthesis runs over uploaded PDFs, details on full-text processing of uploads, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can upload my own PDFs or corpus and have the agent research over them

citations.quote: Turn your library into a research engine. Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.
Import from Zotero ... or import from BibTex, PDF, or RIS
The Consensus Library brings your entire research library into one searchable, AI-powered workspace.
